Settings

Preferences

Camera preferences (mirror, handedness, language) are set in the setup wizard.

Experimental features

These features are in development. They may be less accurate or stable.

Score facial expression (NMM)W4

Adds a 5th feedback component for brow and mouth position. Requires a face in frame. Nothing is uploaded.

On-device personalizationW5

Adapts the model to your hand size and signing style using confirmed attempts. All data stays on your device.

BSL betaW7 beta

British Sign Language beta tier. Accuracy is lower than ASL.

Continuous SLR research previewW8 research

Sentence-level recognition. Much lower accuracy than isolated signs. See /research/continuous.

WebGPU accelerationStretch

Use WebGPU execution provider for faster inference on supported browsers. Falls back to WASM.

Your data

Personalization adapter

No personalization data yet. Enable personalization above and practice to build your adapter.

All data is stored in your browser localStorage. Nothing is uploaded. To delete everything, clear localStorage for this site in your browser DevTools.
